content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Kalyani Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Kalyani to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Kalyani recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Kalyani Project Technical Support - III / Project Nurse - II posts is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support - III / Project Nurse - II posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Support - III and Project Nurse - II positions at AIIMS Kalyani.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support - III, candidates need a Graduate degree in a relevant subject plus a Post Graduate degree in a relevant subject and 1 year of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Nurse - II?
faq.answer: The required qualification for Project Nurse - II is a BSc Nursing from an institute recognized by the Nursing Council of India, along with 1 year of research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts at AIIMS Kalyani is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Technical Support - III position will receive a salary of Rs. 28000/- per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Nurse - II?
faq.answer: The Project Nurse - II position offers a salary of Rs. 20000/- per month, along with HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Kalyani recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification, an MCQ based written examination, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
